services.name: View Rentals
services.desc: One of the best ways to experience Pinantan Lake is from the water. Guests can enjoy complimentary use of our kayaks, canoes, and paddleboards, or rent one of our fishing boats to explore the lake at their own pace. Whether you’re planning a relaxing paddle, a day of fishing, or simply taking in the scenery, our lakeside equipment makes it easy to enjoy your time at the resort. services.name: Cabin Rentals
services.desc: Pinantan Lake Resort offers cozy cabin rentals and full-service RV sites set along the beautiful shores of Pinantan Lake. Guests enjoy a quiet, nature-filled setting just a short drive from Kamloops. Our charming lakeside cabins offer a comfortable and relaxing place to unwind after a day on the water. Choose from spacious two-bedroom lakefront cabins or cozy one-room resort-view cabins, all recently updated and thoughtfully maintained. Whether you’re visiting for fishing, outdoor adventure, or a quiet retreat, our cabins provide the perfect home base at the lake. Bring your RV and settle in for a relaxing stay by the lake.
